title: The Locker of Maple Street
author: Dominic Iversen
blurb: Oscar Fairweather, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
